Pooled-feature union k-NN adjacency

Source: R/penalized_mfa_clusterwise.R
spatial_constraints.Rd

Pooled-feature union k-NN adjacency

Usage

spatial_constraints(coords_list, k_nn = 6, nblocks = NULL, ...)

Arguments

coords_list

List of coordinate matrices (each k_s x 3)

k_nn

Finite nonnegative integer neighbor count (default 6), capped at available non-self vertices. Zero creates no edges. All boundary ties within floating-point tolerance are included, so actual degree may exceed k_nn.

nblocks

Number of blocks (ignored, for compatibility)

Value

Sparse adjacency matrix

Details

Features are pooled across the supplied coordinate blocks. Directed neighbors are symmetrized by union with unit edge weights. Self removal uses vertex identity, including duplicate coordinates. Boundary ties are included regardless of input order. The graph does not distinguish within-block smoothing from between-block correspondence; that scientific distinction remains part of the broader experimental recovery plan.
